paragraphs: Norix Group sells durable furniture for behavioral healthcare, corrections and transitional housing. The catalogue runs from stackable chairs, benches and rockers to lounge seating. Leg style tables and fixed seating options are designed for versatility, safety and endurance.

Bedroom furniture and accessories are offered in wood, steel and molded plastic. Mattresses are made for behavioral health, detention, shelter and higher education settings, in sealed seam and sewn seam styles. Children's furniture is described as working well in daycares, schools and waiting rooms. A line of convex security mirrors uses a steel frame design and polycarbonate surface.
Listed seating features include contraband and tamper resistance along with GreenGuard Gold certification.

quote.text: Each seating solution is crafted to be safe and sanitary without sacrificing comfort.
